verdict.rationale: Flagright documents a public REST API with JSON requests and responses, downloadable OpenAPI specs for both its FRAML and Management APIs, and official Python and Node/TypeScript clients. The documented endpoints cover the core of the product: users, transactions, batch operations, rule instances, cases and alerts. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented (all evidence is vendor docs).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Flagright API is organized around REST. Our API has predictable resource-oriented URLs, accepts JSON-encoded request bodies, returns JSON-encoded responses
Flagright maintains official API clients for Python and Node/Typescript. We recommend using these clients to interact with all stable endpoints.
Download FRAML API OpenAPI ... Download Management API OpenAPI
`POST /rule-instances` endpoint is used to create a new rule instance.
